_comment: The seat roster, the alias map, and the retired seats with the reason each was retired.
CLAUDE.md's seat table (section 5) GOVERNS. This file must agree with it, and
tests/test_role_cards.py fails if the two drift apart.
FIVE SEATS, NOT KORUS'S SEVEN. korus adds a Reviewer; this table has none, so it does not
resolve to a card here. An unmapped label resolves to NOTHING. The hook never guesses.
THE MANAGER IS LIVE HERE, and it is the seat the owner talks to. The Console was RETIRED
2026-09-10 and is NOT a synonym for it: a Manager's workers are subagents in its own
process, on one account, and several Managers run at once. Read its card, not a Console's.
_aliases_comment: Observed and near-miss spellings, collapsed onto the canonical seat. A canonical name is
never a key here: it resolves to itself. Numbered spellings exist because several
sessions hold the same seat at once and the number was appended to tell them apart.
_retired_comment: A retired label resolves to NO CARD, and the hook says it was retired rather than
staying silent. Silence would send the reader looking for a card that was removed.
CLAUDE.md records seven seats retired 2026-09-01 and the Console retired 2026-09-10.
The Console's observed spellings are listed individually ON PURPOSE: an alias must land on a
live seat, so a spelling left out of this map would resolve to 'MATCHES NO SEAT' and read as a
typo. The retirement has to be the loud answer, because substituting the Manager for the
Console is the exact error this retirement was written to stop.
Reviewer is NOT retired here -- it was never a seat in this repository, and it is live in korus.

retired.console: Retired 2026-09-10 by owner decision. The MANAGER replaces it, and is NOT a renamed Console: a Manager's workers are subagents inside its own process on its own account, several Managers run at once, and it needs no spawn grant. It also does not enqueue -- that moved to the Lander. Read docs/roles/manager.card.md and korus roles/MANAGER.md; do not carry a Console rule across.
retired.console1: Retired 2026-09-10, a spelling of 'console'. See the 'console' entry: the Manager replaces it and is not a renamed Console.
retired.console-1: Retired 2026-09-10, a spelling of 'console'. See the 'console' entry: the Manager replaces it and is not a renamed Console.
retired.consul: Retired 2026-09-10, a spelling of 'console'. See the 'console' entry: the Manager replaces it and is not a renamed Console.
retired.dispatcher: Retired 2026-09-01. The Manager replaces it: it reads the record, picks the work and dispatches a Builder.
retired.liaison: Retired 2026-09-01. The Manager replaces it and is the seat the owner talks to.
retired.pm: Retired 2026-09-01 by owner decision. Nothing replaced it.
retired.project-manager: Retired 2026-09-01 by owner decision. Nothing replaced it. It is NOT a spelling of the live 'manager' seat.
retired.cleaner: Retired 2026-09-01 by owner decision. Nothing replaced it.
retired.role-manager: Retired 2026-09-01 by owner decision. Nothing replaced it. It is NOT a spelling of the live 'manager' seat.
retired.process-improvement: Retired 2026-09-01 by owner decision. Nothing replaced it.

_elsewhere_comment: Live in korus, absent from this repository's table, and therefore resolving to nothing
here. Named so a session that holds one of these seats in korus and opens a worktree
here learns why no card arrived, rather than reading silence as a missing file.
The Manager LEFT this map on 2026-09-10: it is live here now, so it resolves to a card.
